caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a natural reddish-brown finish. The cabinet stands on four small rounded feet and features two main sections. The upper section is composed of eight small rectangular drawers arranged in two columns of four rows, each drawer with a decorative brass-colored handle. Below the drawers, the lower section has two larger panel doors, each door adorned with a central decorative handle similar in color and style to those on the drawers. The sides of the cabinet are paneled, and the corners are slightly beveled. The entire piece is rendered with attention to the wood grain and texture, emphasizing the craftsmanship and hardware details. The background is plain and uncolored, keeping the focus entirely on the furniture piece.
title: Highboy (Chest of Drawers)
